## Problem and behavior

What requirement or reproducible failure does this change address?

## Specification and scope

Link the feature directory and relevant REQ / ADR / TASK IDs. Explain exclusions and any design change.

## Validation

Record the tested commit, commands and actual results. Separate local tests, CI, manual checks and preexisting failures. Review for credentials and private data before submitting.

## Assistance

Disclose any AI assistance and confirm you reviewed the change.
